name: drawer
title: Drawer
description: A vaul-style bottom sheet with drag-to-dismiss, snap points, and swipe-to-open edge areas. Built on the @zag-js/drawer machine.
usageSnippet:
<Drawer>
  <@trigger|props|>
    <button ...props>Open</button>
  </@trigger>
  <@title>Are you absolutely sure?</@title>
  <@description>This action cannot be undone.</@description>
  <@footer>
    <button>Submit</button>
  </@footer>
</Drawer>

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description: Whether to close the drawer when the escape key is pressed.

props.name: closeOnInteractOutside
props.description: Whether to close the drawer when the outside is clicked.

props.name: closeThreshold
props.description: The threshold distance for dismissing the drawer.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The initial open state of the drawer.

props.name: defaultSnapPoint
props.description: The default snap point of the drawer.

props.name: defaultTriggerValue
props.description: The default trigger value (uncontrolled).

props.name: dir
props.description: The document's text/writing direction.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Whether the content body itself is draggable, or only the grabber.

props.name: finalFocusEl
props.description: Element to receive focus when the sheet is closed.

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: hideCloseTrigger
props.description: Show the top-right close button.

props.name: hideGrabber
props.description: Hide the vaul-style grab handle (dragging the content body still works).

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the drawer. Useful for composition.

props.name: initialFocusEl
props.description: Element to receive focus when the sheet is opened.

props.name: modal
props.description: Whether to prevent pointer interaction outside the element and hide all content below it.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the drawer is open.

props.name: preventDragOnScroll
props.description:
Whether to prevent dragging on scrollable elements.
When enabled, the sheet will not start dragging if the user is interacting with a scrollable element.

props.name: preventScroll
props.description: Whether to prevent scrolling behind the sheet when it's opened

props.name: restoreFocus
props.description: Whether to restore focus to the element that had focus before the sheet was opened.

props.name: role
props.description: The sheet's role

props.name: snapPoint
props.description: The currently active snap point.

props.name: snapPoints
props.description:
The snap points of the drawer.
Array of numbers or strings representing the snap points.

props.name: snapToSequentialPoints
props.description: Whether the drawer should snap to sequential points when swiping.

props.name: stack
props.description:
Optional external store for coordinating app-level drawer stack visuals
(e.g. indent and background layers).

props.name: swipeArea
props.description: Render an edge swipe area that opens the drawer by swiping inward.

props.name: swipeDirection
props.description: The direction in which the drawer can be swiped.

props.name: swipeVelocityThreshold
props.description: The threshold velocity (in pixels/s) for closing the drawer.

props.name: trapFocus
props.description: Whether to trap focus inside the sheet when it's opened.

props.name: triggerValue
props.description: The value of the trigger that currently controls the drawer.

events.name: onEscapeKeyDown
events.description: Function called when the escape key is pressed

events.name: onFocusOutside
events.description: Function called when the focus is moved outside the component

events.name: onInteractOutside
events.description: Function called when an interaction happens outside the component

events.name: onOpenChange
events.description: Function called when the open state changes.

events.name: onPointerDownOutside
events.description: Function called when the pointer is pressed down outside the component

events.name: onRequestDismiss
events.description: Function called when this layer is closed due to a parent layer being closed

events.name: onSnapPointChange
events.description: Callback fired when the snap point changes.

events.name: onTriggerValueChange
events.description: Callback when the active trigger value changes.

events.name: openChange
events.description: Sugar for onOpenChange — receives the plain boolean, enables `open:=state`.

events.name: snapPointChange
events.description: Sugar for onSnapPointChange — receives the plain snap point.

events.name: triggerValueChange
events.description: Sugar for onTriggerValueChange — receives the plain trigger value.

examples.title: Without footer
examples.source:
import Drawer from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/drawer/drawer.marko";
import Button from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/button/button.marko";

<Drawer>
  <@trigger|props|>
    <Button type="button" ...props variant="outline">View notifications</Button>
  </@trigger>
  <@title>Notifications</@title>
  <@description>You have 3 unread messages.</@description>
</Drawer>
examples.description: The footer tag is optional — omit it for a drawer with no actions row.

examples.title: Position
examples.source:
import Drawer from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/drawer/drawer.marko";
import Button from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/button/button.marko";

<Drawer swipeDirection="end">
  <@trigger|props|>
    <Button type="button" ...props variant="outline">Open from the right</Button>
  </@trigger>
  <@title>Side drawer</@title>
  <@description>Logical `end` resolves to right in LTR, left in RTL.</@description>
</Drawer>
examples.description: Set `swipeDirection` to `up`, `right`, `down`, or `left` to change which edge the drawer opens from.

examples.title: Swipe handle
examples.source:
import Drawer from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/drawer/drawer.marko";
import Button from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/button/button.marko";

<Drawer swipeDirection="up">
  <@trigger|props|>
    <Button type="button" ...props variant="outline">Up</Button>
  </@trigger>
  <@title>Up drawer</@title>
  <@description>Drawer with a swipe handle.</@description>
  <div class="h-80 w-full bg-muted"/>
</Drawer>
examples.description: Our drawer always renders a drag grabber unless `hideGrabber` is set — there's no separate `showSwipeHandle` toggle to opt into, since the grabber is the default rather than an add-on.

examples.title: Nested
examples.source:
import Drawer from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/drawer/drawer.marko";
import Button from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/button/button.marko";

<Drawer swipeDirection="down">
  <@trigger|props|>
    <Button type="button" ...props variant="outline">Down</Button>
  </@trigger>
  <@title>Down drawer</@title>
  <@description>Open another drawer from the same direction.</@description>
  <div class="h-80 w-full bg-muted"/>
  <@footer>
    <Drawer swipeDirection="down">
      <@trigger|props|>
        <Button type="button" ...props>Open nested drawer</Button>
      </@trigger>
      <@title>Nested drawer</@title>
      <@description>The parent drawer stays mounted behind this one.</@description>
      <div class="h-80 w-full bg-muted"/>
    </Drawer>
  </@footer>
</Drawer>
examples.description: Open a drawer from inside another drawer. Our @zag-js/drawer port stacks nested drawers as independent instances — it does not implement upstream's stacked-indent visual (the parent drawer does not scale/dim behind the frontmost one).

examples.title: Non modal
examples.source:
import Drawer from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/drawer/drawer.marko";
import Button from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/button/button.marko";

<Drawer modal=false closeOnInteractOutside=false swipeDirection="end">
  <@trigger|props|>
    <Button type="button" ...props variant="outline">Non Modal</Button>
  </@trigger>
  <@title>Non Modal Drawer</@title>
  <div class="h-80 w-full bg-muted"/>
</Drawer>
examples.description: Set `modal={false}` to allow interaction with the rest of the page while the drawer is open, and `closeOnInteractOutside={false}` (our equivalent of upstream's `disablePointerDismissal`) to keep outside presses from closing it.

import Drawer from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/drawer/drawer.marko"; import Button from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/button/button.marko"; <@trigger|props|> <@title>Snap points <@description>Drag the handle to snap between 40%, 70% and full height.

The drawer resolves each snap point against the viewport and settles on the nearest one when you release the drag.

Row ${index}

examples.source:
import Dialog from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/dialog/dialog.marko"; import Drawer from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/drawer/drawer.marko"; import Button from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/button/button.marko"; import TextInput from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/input/input.marko"; import Label from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/label/label.marko"; { isDesktop = query.matches; }; update(); query.addEventListener("change", update); return { cleanup: () => query.removeEventListener("change", update) }; } onDestroy() { this.cleanup?.(); } /> <@trigger|props|> <@title>Edit profile <@description>Make changes to your profile here. Click save when you're done.
<@trigger|props|> <@title>Edit profile <@description>Make changes to your profile here. Click save when you're done.
<@footer>
examples.description: Combine `Dialog` and `Drawer` to render a dialog on desktop and a drawer on mobile, switching on a `matchMedia` breakpoint check.

composition: `<Drawer>` is a single component, not a composed tree — `@trigger` is a render-prop slot (spread the given props onto your own trigger element), and `@title`/`@description`/`@footer` are named body slots plus the tag's own default body that render into the drawer's header, body, and footer regions. Omit any slot you don't need; `@title`/`@description` render nothing without a wrapping header until at least one is supplied, and `@footer` is fully optional (see the “Without footer” example below).
